item.title: Why Rust Makes C++ Programmers Lose Sleep at Night: Lessons from My Migration Journey
item.description: A C++ developer with 5 years of experience shares real insights from switching to Rust. From memory safety to concurrency, these 10 features completely changed my perspective on systems programming

item.title: A 1000x Gap: How Google Used Rust to Push Memory-Safety Bugs Below 20% — and the Playbook You Can Copy
item.description: In 2025 Google disclosed that memory-safety vulnerabilities on Android fell below 20% for the first time, and Rust code carries roughly 1000x fewer memory-safety bugs per million lines than C/C++. This article breaks down why, shows a C/Rust use-after-free comparison, and gives an actionable checklist.

item.title: Building a B+Tree in Rust: What I Got Wrong Before Getting It Right
item.description: A walkthrough of design mistakes I made implementing a B+Tree in Rust — from treating all nodes as in-memory pointers to understanding database pages, buffer pools, and record IDs. For developers learning database internals or systems programming in Rust.

item.title: Rust Smart Pointers Complete Guide: Box, Rc, and RefCell Explained with Code Examples
item.description: Master Rust smart pointers: Box, Rc, RefCell, and the powerful Rc<RefCell<T>> combo. Learn heap allocation, reference counting, and interior mutability through vivid analogies. Beginner to intermediate level.

item.title: Go Memory Allocator: A Warehouse Manager's Tale
item.description: From 64MB warehouses to 8KB shelves, discover how Go's three-level cache architecture makes memory allocation blazing fast. Deep dive into arena, span, and size class design philosophy.

item.title: Stop Rewriting! The Rust FFI Sandwich: Keep Your C Code Running While You Add Safety
item.description: Rust FFI Sandwich incremental migration: stop the big-bang rewrite, wrap your C code in Rust safety layers, and migrate one function at a time while production keeps running.

item.title: Rust 1.93 Released: musl Upgrade, Assembly Conditional Compilation, Zero-Copy Suite
item.description: Rust 1.93 is out with all musl targets upgraded to 1.2.5, #[cfg] conditional compilation in assembly, global allocators can now use TLS, and zero-copy APIs stabilized.

item.title: Rust mmap Memory-Mapped I/O: Why Reading Files Can Be as Fast as Accessing Memory
item.description: A plain-English guide to Rust mmap memory-mapped I/O. Why is it 5-10x faster than traditional Rust file reading? How does zero-copy achieve Rust performance optimization? This memmap2 hands-on tutorial uses real-life analogies to help you understand this seemingly mysterious low-level technology.

item.title: Linux 6.19 Rust Module Parameter Support: Rust Driver Development Enters Production Stage
item.description: Linux 6.19 kernel provides complete module parameter support for Rust drivers, marking Rust's transition from experimental to production in kernel development. This article details the module_param! macro usage, comparisons with C, memory safety advantages, and future trends in Rust driver development.

item.title: Rust Performance Optimization: 7 Underused Features Every Senior Developer Knows
item.description: Deep dive into 7 underrated Rust features for systems programming performance optimization. From p99 latency tuning to memory management, these advanced Rust techniques will make your production code perform better.

item.title: Rust File Distribution & Hot Reload: Managing Your Code Like a Delivery Network Pro
item.description: Learn Rust file distribution, config synchronization, and hot code reloading through vivid delivery service analogies - manage code deployment like running a delivery empire

item.title: Rust Borrow Checker Explained: A Beginner's Guide to Ownership, Borrowing, and Lifetimes
item.description: A deep but simple dive into Rust's core concept: the Borrow Checker. Using a vivid analogy, this article explains ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes, helping you conquer compile errors and master Rust's safety.

item.title: Rust Smart Pointers Explained: A Practical Guide to Box, Rc, and RefCell
item.description: Learn Rust smart pointers through vivid analogies and practical examples. Master Box, Rc, and RefCell to understand Rust's memory management system effortlessly
